This app requires no registration and collects none of your information. Your commission data stays on your own phone. Its only network activity is checking for updates, which reads a version number and uploads nothing.
· No account system — no phone number, email, or ID verification needed
· No device identifiers collected (IMEI, Android ID, MAC address, etc.)
· No usage behavior, crash logs, or location data collected
· No ads, no third-party analytics / tracking SDKs
· No servers — a copy of your data simply doesn\'t exist on our side
Let us be clear about networking first: this version added update checks, so it requests the INTERNET permission — that is its only use.

It uploads nothing: checking for updates only downloads a tiny version file, with no device ID, no commission content and no analytics. The network permission you see under Settings → Apps → Commission Ledger → Permissions exists for that one purpose.
· Commission records (artist, content, total price, paid, status, due date, notes) and artist contact info are all stored in this app\'s private directory on this phone
· Only this app can read it; other apps can\'t (unless your phone is rooted)
· Uninstalling the app deletes the data along with it — once gone, it can\'t be recovered
· Want to keep it? Export a backup yourself: Settings → Backup & Restore → Export Backup
· Delete items one by one in the app, or archive them
· Uninstalling the app = deleting all data
· There\'s no copy on our end to delete, because we never had your data in the first place
5. About Built-in Cloud Backup (This Needs to Be Clear)
Android has a built-in "back up to cloud" feature (your phone maker\'s cloud service, or Google Backup). If it\'s on, this app\'s data may be backed up to your cloud account by the system.
This is decided by your phone\'s system and your account settings — the app doesn\'t take part and can\'t see it. If you don\'t want it backed up, turn off "App Data Backup" in your system settings.
· A backup is a JSON file that you export yourself — where it\'s saved and who you send it to is entirely up to you
· Once you send it to someone (WeChat, QQ, cloud drive, etc.), that file is no longer protected by this app — it contains artist contact info, so keep it safe
This app collects no personal information, so there\'s no issue of "collecting minors\' information." Minors should use it with a guardian\'s knowledge.

· Its only network activity: reading a small version file to see whether a newer build exists
· It uses the INTERNET permission; new versions install through the system installer, and you confirm every install
· The request carries none of your data: no device ID, no commission records, no analytics, no cookies
· To stay fully offline: turn off automatic update checks in Settings → Updates and it makes no requests at all

· Honestly: any request itself lets the other side see your IP address, which file was requested, when, and the app name declared in the request header (CommissionBook-Android). No network request can avoid that, this app cannot change it, and it cannot make promises on behalf of anyone else.

· One more layer: GitHub is often unreachable from mainland China, so update checks try public acceleration mirrors first (free services such as gh-proxy.com) and the request passes through them. They are third parties, not servers belonging to this app. If that bothers you, turn off automatic update checks in Settings → Updates and the app makes no requests at all.
